summary_zh: 這片苔蘚熔岩原屬於廣大的 Eldhraun，由1783至1784年的拉基火山噴發形成。可從一號公路旁的安全停靠處欣賞，但苔蘚極為脆弱，受損後可能需要數十年以上才能恢復；請留在既有步道與停車區，絕對不要踩踏、觸摸或駕車進入熔岩原。
summary_en: This mossy lava field, part of the vast Eldhraun formed by the 1783‑1784 Laki eruption, can be viewed from the safe pull‑over area next to Route 1. The moss is extremely fragile and may take decades to recover if damaged, so stay on the existing trail and parking area; do not step on, touch, or drive onto the lava field. Parking is free, but there are no restroom facilities. Allocate about 60 minutes for the visit.
